name: Claybridge Sound Systems / Ralph Norman Bridges
dirt_evidence: Fuzzmaster; Fuzzmaster MKIV and related Fuzzmaster variants
notes: Ralph Bridges operated Claybridge Sound Systems in Clayton, Victoria. Specialist historical research identifies a 1966 Fuzzmaster as his first fuzz pedal and documents multiple later Fuzzmaster forms. The 1971 Commonwealth Gazette confirms Bridges trading as Claybridge Sound. Preserve uncertainty around exact model-to-model chronology while treating the maker attribution as verified.
